verdicts.reason: A keeps the logo (fig and wordmark) at a usable size and reads left to right. But the pink ellipse is pushed right and cropped at the top, bottom and right edges, and its left edge cuts behind 'Lumen & Fig'. The fig is also jammed close to the top and bottom edges, and the tagline is slightly bigger than the brand name. B shrinks the logo to a tiny, barely readable wordmark (around 12px) while the tagline takes over, which flips the brand's hierarchy. It also leaves a large empty pink area on the right, so the brand barely survives.
